cds.text: Collect, sort and compare data shown by objects and images to answer given questions about familiar situations
Acquire and record categorical data in various ways (digital tools, objects, images, drawings, lists, tally marks, symbols)
Acquire categorical data through surveys, observation, experiments and digital tools; sort into categories and display in lists and tables
Represent collected categorical data using one-to-one displays and digital tools; compare frequencies and discuss findings
Create different graphical representations of data using software where appropriate; compare them and describe common and distinctive features
